title: Visible motion replays; off-screen motion stops
authorityNote: This decision outranks the Landometer Design System in every version, and any product add-on rule that conflicts with it. Where LDS 0.9.1 [MOTION] requires a play-once entrance reveal or forbids looping ambience, this decision governs.
decision: Every animation replays automatically for as long as it is inside the viewport, and stops as soon as it leaves the viewport.
verbatimInstruction: ปรับให้ ทุก animation autoreplay ตลอดเวลาที่มองเห็นอยู่ เมื่อเลื่อนผ่านไปมองไม่เห็นให้ viewport แล้วค่อยหยุด · กฎนี้ให้ใหญ่กว่า Design System เสมอ
scope: decks and documents rendered in a browser
every portable snippet handed to a team or agent
supersedes: LDS 0.9.1 [MOTION] motion-riddim-approach-02 once-only reveal contract, for repetition only
LDS 0.9.1 prohibition on looping ambience and infinite attention animation
motif-library 1.2.1 condition that library auto-replay is an inspection aid and must not be copied into portable snippets
CityChat AMENDMENT CC-MOTION-02 clause 'play once', for repetition only
stillBinding: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is a user-device kill switch, not a design-system rule — reduced motion holds the final state and starts no cycle
no-JavaScript and print routes render the final state
no layout shift, no obscured action, no scroll-jacking, no hue cycling
motion never carries evidence, contrast, meaning or comprehension
one cycle length still comes from the family lifecycle (finite_once, finite_once_logo_sting, state_bound_only); the owner rule governs repetition, not duration
state-bound motifs still appear only while the real state is running

implementationContract.onEnter: play immediately, then repeat every cycle length
implementationContract.onExit: clear the timer and hold the final state
implementationContract.technique: repeated finite plays — never animation-iteration-count: infinite, so the CityChat 'no infinite' check still passes
implementationContract.pageControl: one page-level pause/resume control, carried over from the 1.2.1 showcase decision
implementationContract.failOpen: a runtime that never loads leaves the approved still image in place

appliedIn.how: hero dial, six Landometer full/quiet tiles (lm-motif loop), four CityChat motifs (inline runtime SVG re-armed), two ijji logo stings (replay cadence)
